data.name: The link to the brand's home page.
A dummy number for testing.
data.value: 一個用於測試的虛擬數字。

data.name: Allow users to adjust their nickname in the profile management page.
data.value: 允許用戶在個人資料管理頁面調整其暱稱。

data.name: Master switch for semantic (vector-based) incident search. When enabled and all dependencies are configured, search results display a green \"Search based on AI (Vector Database)\" badge and use cosine similarity ranking via the embedding model. When disabled, or when dependencies are missing, search silently falls back to keyword matching without the badge. Requires Embedding Ollama Instance and Embedding Model.
data.value: 語義（基於向量）事件搜尋的主開關。啟用並完成所有依賴項配置後，搜尋結果將顯示綠色「AI 搜尋（向量資料庫）」徽章，並透過嵌入模型使用餘弦相似度排序。若停用或依賴項缺失，搜尋將無聲地回退至關鍵字匹配，且不顯示徽章。需配置 Embedding Ollama Instance 和 Embedding Model。

data.name: Maximum number of cached query embeddings in the database. When exceeded, the least recently accessed entries are evicted (LRU). Default 2000. Adjust based on your database capacity and expected query diversity.
data.value: 資料庫中快取的查詢嵌入（embeddings）的最大數量。超過此限制時，會移除最長時間未被存取（LRU）的項目。預設值為 2000。請根據資料庫容量及預期的查詢多樣性進行調整。

data.name: The bearer token for authenticating with the Embedding Ollama Instance, e.g. 5a0fbdefa19f....
data.value: 用於驗證嵌入 Ollama 實例的 Bearer Token，例如 5a0fbdefa19f....

data.name: The brand name displayed in the footer.
data.value: 顯示於頁尾的品牌名稱

data.name: The embedding model name, e.g. bge-m3:latest. Must be available at the Embedding Ollama Instance. Only used for vector search.
data.value: 嵌入模型名稱，例如 bge-m3:latest。必須在嵌入 Ollama 實例中可用。僅用於向量搜尋。

data.name: The ICP license number for China mainland users. Leave empty to hide.
data.value: 適用於中國內地用戶的ICP許可證編號。留空則隱藏。

data.name: The logo of the project displayed in the navbar and footer. Support jpg, png, svg.
data.value: 項目圖標顯示於導航列及頁腳。支援 jpg、png、svg 格式。

data.name: The name of the project displayed in the frontend.
data.value: 項目在前端顯示的名稱。

data.name: The Ollama API base URL used specifically for generating incident and query embeddings (vector search). Only the host is used — /api/embed is appended automatically. E.g. https://ollama.example.com
data.value: 專用於生成事件及查詢嵌入（向量搜尋）嘅 Ollama API 基礎 URL。只使用主機部分 — /api/embed 會自動附加。例如 https://ollama.example.com
